Plan_of_Care.content: Advise drinking plenty of water to replace fluid losses.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: You still need to drink plenty of water because you're losing a lot of fluids.

Plan_of_Care.content: Follow a soft diet and avoid dairy, fish, meat, and eggs while having diarrhea.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: things that one would advise is a soft diet. So avoid dairy, fish, meat, eggs, while you're having the diarrhea.

Plan_of_Care.content: Suggested soft foods include crackers, toast, and jam that are easily digested.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: that will be like crackers, toast, jam, those kind of things that's easily digested.

Plan_of_Care.content: When tolerating intake, start boiled vegetables and mashed foods.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Once you are able to, you know keep most of it in, you can start off with some just boiled vegetables and mash.

Plan_of_Care.content: After 48 hours without diarrhea, reintroduce meat, eggs, and fish.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Forty-eight hours you're not having any diarrhea, you're fine then you can go and start having meat, egg, fish and all.

Plan_of_Care.content: Avoid milk; yogurt is recommended as a probiotic.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: although you can't milk is not a good idea, yoghurts are a good idea because they are probiotics, it help to build up the normal, um gut, gut bacteria back.

Plan_of_Care.content: Consider over-the-counter Dioralyte to replace lost salts.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: you could get something called Dioralyte over the counter. So, it helps to uh, replenish your, the salts that you've been, that's lost through going to the toilet.

Follow_up_Information.content: If diarrhea persists for one week or if blood appears in the stool, arrange a stool sample.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if your diarrhoea doesn't go away in a week's time, or if you're passing blood, we need a stool sample

Follow_up_Information.content: If bowel movements reach about 6 to 8 times per day, there is a high risk of dehydration and hospital care may be needed.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if you're going about six to eight times a day, that means there's a high chance that, uh, you are, having dehydration and you might need to go into hospital at that point in time.

Follow_up_Information.content: If frequency increases or dehydration risk arises, contact the clinic again.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If that happens you get in touch with us again, all right?

Follow_up_Information.content: Seek medical attention if diarrhea exceeds eight times per day.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: when we start worrying about diarrhea is if you're going more than eight times a day.
